value.rationale: This is a complete centered-distribution and mean-level comparison across every fixed-size seed allocation for a natural core-periphery family. It shows the persistent, explicit Exp(k) delay for peripheral-only starting configurations, distinguishes seed location from seed count and supplies exact finite all-deadline ordering. Such an O(1) distributional penalty is not furnished by mere logarithmic flooding scale estimates.
